narrativeProgression.description: Imran Khan asserts the democratic nature of his government and their willingness to address concerns about election fairness.
Imran Khan emphasizes the strong and harmonious relationship between the government and the military, highlighting their collaborative approach to policy-making.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is a democratic government. We want an election, we challenge anyone to question the election.
We ask the opposition, name us any constituencies, you didn't get a fair result. We are ready

relationship. We have complete coordination. We work together. The military completely
stands with all the democratic governments, policies, whether it is with India, whether
it is for peaceful solution in Afghanistan, everywhere the military stands with us.
